purpose: Match the locked idle sprite's thin contours and slender proportions; correct running anatomy.

prompts:
Use case: style-transfer, identity-preserving game animation correction.
Input image 1 is the edit target, an existing animation source sheet. Input image 2 is the LOCKED master idle sprite, enlarged with nearest-neighbor solely to inspect the authentic final low-resolution art. Match image 2, not the thicker/chubbier style of image 1.
Correct the existing animation sheet so every pose is visibly the SAME slender young fox-eared girl as the idle master. Keep all existing pose counts, row/column ordering, gestures, facing right, weapon positions, and motion timing. Keep the honey-yellow and chestnut palette, warm ivory modest tunic, brown shorts over full dark leggings, small mustard cape, gloves, laced boots, golden fox ears and cream-tipped fluffy tail. Keep her youthful face, small eyes and small slim head; do not make head/face rounder or bigger than idle. A neutral standing figure should have the same head-to-body ratio as idle: roughly 96 logical pixels tall including ears.
THIN OUTLINES: idle is the final rendering standard. Thin dark brown/plum exterior contours, predominantly ONE native pixel when rendered at 96px body height; thin selective interior contours. No thick black cartoon perimeter, no doubled contours. Keep small clean square color clusters, just 2-3 shades per material, simplified face/hair/clothes. Coherent coarse low-resolution game pixels, no high-detail illustration, no high-resolution smooth linework, no blur, no antialiasing, no glow, no gradients. Do not add fine detail as a substitute for thin lines.
Keep natural pose foreshortening and flexed knees, but consistent skull size, face size, shoulder width, boot size and limb thickness across frames. All character and weapon pixels must be inside the canvas, comfortably separated from adjacent poses. Fully genuine transparent background; NO ground, shadows, halos, colored haze, text, grid lines, numbered frames, captions or watermark.
Her only weapon is the same beginner TWO-HANDED GREATSWORD: broad straight silver blade, blue-gray steel shadow, simple brass crossguard, straight chestnut grip. Blade centerline, crossguard midpoint, grip and pommel must be mechanically aligned on one uninterrupted rigid axis in EVERY pose. Do not bend the handle.

Layout and motion invariants:
EXACTLY EIGHT full-body running poses, FOUR columns by TWO rows, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Preserve the eight existing running leg/arm phases, no duplicated idle poses. The reference girl runs toward screen-right with her sword held trailing behind her. Keep all eight poses distinct, and keep their heads the same size.

No third forearm, no free swinging hand, no extra wrist, no second pair of gloves, no flesh-colored objects at her front waist.
Keep all EIGHT distinct RUNNING phases, FOUR columns by TWO rows, exact pose order, leg/boot motion, facing right, complete tails, ears, weapons and heads. Preserve master idle's slender proportions, small head/face, palette and thin dark-brown contours predominantly ONE pixel at 96px native character height. Do not enlarge head or add details.
Sword is one rigid straight object: broad silver blade, brass guard, straight brown long two-hand grip, aligned pommel. All hands, ears, boots and full sword must be inside each pose; poses separated by transparent space.
True transparent alpha background. No glow, haze, shadows, motion trails, ground, grid, numbers, labels, text, watermark, smooth antialiasing or heavy black outlines.
